nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'cybernetic-dyad-philosophy-and-anti-swarm-thesis' with goal: Consolidate philosophical thesis on the Cybernetic Dyad (1 Human + 1 Entity + 1 Externalized Substrate), anti-swarm state-first architecture, cross-session reuse via cave mineral veins, and anti-zombie craftsmanship

Consolidated foundational thesis: (1) The Persona Fallacy & Swarm Cargo-Cult vs. Cybernetic Dyad (1 Human + 1 Entity + 1 Externalized Substrate). (2) State-First vs. Actor-First coordination (deterministic DAG over noisy conversational message passing). (3) The Cave as a Mineral Deposit: passive, high-density cross-session reuse guided by human steersman associative pointers. (4) Anti-Zombie Software craftsmanship: enduring software with intrinsic beauty and intentionality vs. disposable synthetic blobs. (5) Ancient novelty: grounding in millennia of human cognitive crystallization.

Concluded philosophical consolidation: codifying the Cybernetic Dyad (1 Human Steersman + 1 Computational Entity + 1 Externalized Substrate), state-first vs. actor-first coordination, the Cave as a passive mineral deposit for cross-session reuse, and anti-zombie craftsmanship into docs/for_devs.md. Connected via lattice bond to interactive-showcase-demo-tab. All tasks satisfied.
